title: ExeBench-FHD: Addressing Fidelity Issues in Decompiler Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.28212v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: ExeBench is one of the most widely used benchmarks for evaluating LLM-based decompilers. We analyze ExeBench and identify nine issues that affect how faithfully a test measures a decompiler. Three of them prevent LLM decompilers from recovering C code from ExeBench's function. These are ambiguous parameter order when integer and floating-point types are mixed, unused parameters that optimized assembly may drop, and constants stored outside the function's assembly code. Six more affect test validity: non-void functions without a return, placeholder types, static or inline functions removed by the optimizer, functions named main, trivial bodies and truncated definitions. We present ExeBench-FHD, a backward-compatible revision of ExeBench that adds 16 new fields: call-site assembly, data sections, test wrappers, linked-binary disassembly and five warning flags. In ExeBench, 38.9% of functions have at least one of the five flags; dropping

translated_title: ExeBench-FHD：解决反编译器评估中的保真度问题
translated_abstract: ExeBench是评估基于大语言模型（LLM）的反编译器最广泛使用的基准之一。我们分析了ExeBench并识别出九个影响测试对反编译器测量保真度的问题。其中三个问题阻碍了LLM反编译器从ExeBench的函数中恢复C代码：整数和浮点类型混合时的参数顺序歧义、被优化汇编代码可能丢弃的未使用参数、以及存储在函数汇编代码之外的常量。另外六个问题影响测试有效性：缺少返回语句的非void函数、占位符类型、被优化器移除的static或inline函数、命名为main的函数、平凡简单的函数体以及被截断的定义。我们提出了ExeBench-FHD，这是ExeBench的一个向后兼容的修订版本，新增了16个字段：调用点汇编代码、数据段、测试包装器、链接二进制反汇编代码以及五个警告标志。在ExeBench中，38.9%的函数至少带有五个警告标志中的一个；剔除……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文分析了广泛使用的反编译器评测基准ExeBench中影响评估保真度的九个问题，并提出了向后兼容的修订版ExeBench-FHD，通过新增16个字段更忠实地评估基于LLM的反编译器。
